name: todo
description: Atomic repository task routing with tiered retries, persistent threads, a local rebase merge queue, and telemetry.

interface.shortDescription: Atomic tasks with a persistent merge queue
interface.longDescription: Decomposes repository mutations into an atomic task DAG, selects the lowest adequate model tier and escalates retries, executes in runner-owned worktrees with persistent per-task Codex threads, and sends merge delivery through a singleton local rebase queue that returns conflicts to the original thread before fast-forwarding the target. Connector and Git preflight, owner-thread dashboard lifecycle, and attempt telemetry remain durable and repository-local.
defaultPrompt: Use $todo:route to route this repository change through ToDo.
Use $todo:run with a referenced task file to execute it in this thread.
Use $todo:status to show tasks and workers.
